answer_1.quote: The task of few-shot relational learning (FSRL) aims to predict new triplets for a relation r given only a small set of support triplets.

answer_2.quote: For evaluation, we adopt two widely used metrics: MRR (mean reciprocal rank) and Hits@k (with k = 1, 5, 10).

answer_3.quote: To align with the relational entity embeddings for initialization as provided by GMatching , we construct a corresponding set of pre-trained semantic entity embeddings ... using pretrained weights from GloVe and BERT-base-uncased

answer_4.quote: We compare our method against baseline methods under the most common 1-shot and 5-shot settings.
